notes.title: NEW GAME MODE: MINIGAMES ONLY
notes.content:
Hello,

As requested by some players, Alien League has now a new game mode where there is no board, just minigame after minigame in which players battle for the most wins!

[h1][b]--------| UPDATE v1.2 |--------[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW game mode: MINIGAMES ONLY[/b]

[*] Added the option to change the length of the game in both game modes
[*] Fixed a crash where the game would completely stop
[/list]

notes.title: ALIEN LEAGUE v1.1 UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34530226/90ed6d9fd6dffa6afd1d20e48f7743b8d5575631.png[/img]

The first update is here and it brings 15 brand new minigames! Now there are a total of 70 minigames for you to play and compete with your friends!

[h1][b]Update v1.1[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] 15 new minigames
[*] Visuals improvements
[*]Board
[list]
[*] Shop item PORTAL cost reduced from 10 to 5 coins
[*] Shop item 2x MULTIPLIER cost reduced from 10 to 5 coins
[*] Shop item 3x MULTIPLIER cost reduced from 15 to 10 coins
[/list]
[/list]
